payload.description: Structured fields for composite types (blood pressure, fluid, falls, etc.).

displayUntil.description: Last calendar day the message should display (UTC, inclusive)

errors.description: Validation messages or structured error details

dose.description: Dose for this administration time; falls back to medication dose when omitted

daysOfWeek.description: Weekdays when pattern is weekly (e.g. MONDAY, FRIDAY)

howAssisted.description: How assisted (free text or lookup label)

monthlyDayOfMonth.description: Day of month (1–31) when schedulePattern is MONTHLY and monthlyAnchorToStartDate is false

schedules.description: One row per administration time (e.g. 3 times daily → 3 schedule rows for carer MAR check-off)

date.description: UTC date key for today in the chart period

missed.description: Recorded today with status N or R only

completionThroughDate.description: Last calendar date (UTC) included in completion stats: min(today, periodEnd), or full period when viewing a past month

scheduledToDate.description: Scheduled dose-slots from period start through completionThroughDate (excludes N/A and PRN-empty days)

documented.description: Scheduled slots with any administration event (any status code)

stillOpen.description: Scheduled slots in the window with no administration record yet

given.description: Documented slots with given codes: G, F, I, S, T

notGiven.description: Documented slots with refused, missed, held, cancelled, or other non-given codes

prnAdministered.description: PRN administrations recorded in the completion window (separate from scheduled completion)

cellState.description: due = scheduled, no event; recorded = administration logged; na = not scheduled; prn = PRN, no administration that day

areaIds.description: When omitted, all active schedule areas are included

actualEndDateTime.description: Actual end time (ISO 8601); defaults to now for visits
